theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), (∀ (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (P + 1))) (m + 1)) (f : Eucl (P + 1) → Eucl P), IsIntegerMultiplicity Z → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ Z.support)) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (P + 1))) (m + 1)), (∃ N : Set (Eucl (P + 1)), IsOpen N ∧ Z.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ y ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (P + 1)) (m + 1)) y = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (f y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f y)) → S ω = Z η) → ∀ (R : ℝ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.support ⊆ closedBall 0 R → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → C ω = X ψ) → IsIntegerMultiplicity C
